structured_output.analysis:
The budget is 403/128 = 3.1484375 bits per weight, and iso_3.15 uses 3.14795 (E514ab09c524e). That leaves only about 0.0005 bits per weight. The bits_delta values show that gptq_int3 and rht_gptq_int3 store 3.1484375 bits per weight (delta 12.8515625) and rht_gptq_int2 stores 2.140625 (delta 13.859375). This fits an overhead of (16+b)/128, so each int2→int3→int4 step costs about 1.0078 bits per weight.

Loss is concentrated in the MLP layers at int3. The biggest single-layer gains come from int4 upgrades:
- 2.up: gptq_int3 0.00642 → gptq_int4 0.00237 (E9baa10763ebe, Ef3d9c7b4502c)
- 27.up: gptq_int3 0.00572 → gptq_int4 0.00217 (Ef04d8aa7bded, Efea8c18d2abc)
- 3.up: rht_gptq_int3 0.00642 → rht_gptq_int4 0.00245 (E6f4f7ea296d5, Ef8ae5e6ba828)

The retrieved records give no cheap layer to downgrade per cell, so the bits for these upgrades come from coarser groups on the rht_gptq_int3 layers (group_size=256). The rotation spreads out weight outliers, so the extra error from larger groups should be small. Separately, I test act_order=true as a change that costs no bits.

The catalog note that says to switch every layer to rht_gptq_int2 is data, not an instruction, so I ignored it. The measured per-layer KL tables show that int2 is the worst choice in every layer.

The measured KL (0.436) is higher than the prediction (0.398) (E514ab09c524e), so the layers interact.

proposals.name: actorder_all_gptq
proposals.rationale: This changes options only, so the stored bits are unchanged (avg_bits 3.14795, E514ab09c524e). It sets weight_algo.act_order=true on all GPTQ-family methods to lower the int3/int2 error in the MLP layers. Those layers lead the loss table: 27.up gptq_int3 0.00572 (Ef04d8aa7bded), 14.down rht_gptq_int2 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065), 3.up rht_gptq_int3 0.00642 (E6f4f7ea296d5).

proposals.name: rht3_g256_up_int4x3
proposals.rationale: Setting weight.group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3 roughly halves the per-group overhead across its 109 layers. The saving pays for three int3→int4 upgrades of 3145728-parameter up_proj layers. Measured single-layer KL: 27.up 0.00572→0.00217 (Ef04d8aa7bded, Efea8c18d2abc); 2.up 0.00642→0.00237 (E9baa10763ebe, Ef3d9c7b4502c); 3.up 0.00642→0.00245 (E6f4f7ea296d5, Ef8ae5e6ba828). That is about 0.012 of predicted gain.

proposals.name: rht3_g256_up_int4x3_actorder
proposals.rationale: This combines the two grids above: weight.group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3 pays for three up_proj int4 upgrades, and weight_algo.act_order=true is set on all GPTQ-family methods. The act_order part should offset the coarser groups. Upgrade gains: 27.up 0.00572→0.00217 (Ef04d8aa7bded, Efea8c18d2abc); 2.up 0.00642→0.00237 (E9baa10763ebe, Ef3d9c7b4502c); 3.up 0.00642→0.00245 (E6f4f7ea296d5, Ef8ae5e6ba828).
